name: 05_explainer_cloud_computing
description: Explainer with double meanings: cloud, python, mouse

request.script: Cloud computing means your files and programs live on servers in large data centers, not on your own laptop. A small team can rent that computing power by the hour. Developers often write Python scripts to automate the boring parts of their work. With a few clicks of a mouse, a new server can be running in minutes. This flexibility has changed how startups grow.
